changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Two. Keep harvests moving, using succession planting and intercropping.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Pedi. Etsa hore dikotulo di tswele pele ka succession planting le intercropping.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Three. Choose staples that protect you when one crop fails.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Tharo. Khetha staples tse o sireletsang when one crop fails.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Four. Read a pest problem before you treat it.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Nne. Read a pest problem pele o e phekola.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: One. Build the right bed — matching the width and the bed type to your soil and your rainfall.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Nngwe. Build the right bed — width le bed type di tsamaisana le soil ya hao le rainfall ya hao.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Two. Keep harvests moving, using succession planting and intercropping.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Tsha vhuvhili. Itani uri harvests dzi bvele phanḓa, ni tshi shumisa succession planting na intercropping.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Three. Choose staples that protect you when one crop fails.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Tsha vhuraru. Nangani staples dzi ni tsireledzaho when one crop fails.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Four. Read a pest problem before you treat it.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Tsha vhuṋa. Read a pest problem ni sa athu u treat it.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Two. Keep harvests moving, using succession planting and intercropping.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Xa vumbirhi. Endla leswaku ku tshovela ku ya mahlweni hi ku tirhisa succession planting na intercropping.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Three. Choose staples that protect you when one crop fails.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Xa vunharhu. Hlawula staples leti ku sirhelelaka loko xibyariwa xin'we xi tsandzeka.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Four. Read a pest problem before you treat it.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Xa vumune. Read a pest problem u nga si xi tshungula.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: One. Build the right bed — matching the width and the bed type to your soil and your rainfall.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Xo sungula. Build the right bed — width na bed type swi fambisana ni soil ya wena na rainfall ya wena.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Before exchanging seed, check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Pele o fapanyetsana peo, check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed.
retainedEnglishSourceSegments: check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Before exchanging seed, check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Loko u nga si cincana hi mbewu, check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed.
retainedEnglishSourceSegments: check whether the variety is protected and whether permission is needed.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Look for ice and plant damage, compare low ground with slopes, and check minimum temperatures where you can. Mark places where cold or damage lasts longest. Keep sensitive plants away from the cold pockets you observe.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Ṱolani ice na u tshinyala ha zwimela, ni vhambedze fhethu hu re fhasi na u sendama ha mavu, nahone ni tole minimum temperatures hune zwa konadzea. Swayani fhethu hune u rothola kana tshinyalo zwa dzula lwa tshifhinga tshilapfusesa. Keep sensitive plants away from the cold pockets dzine na dzi vhona.
retainedEnglishSourceSegments: Keep sensitive plants away from the cold pockets

beforeTarget.text: Sedzani ice and plant damage, compare low ground with slopes, and check minimum temperatures where you can. Mark places where cold or damage lasts longest. Keep sensitive plants away from the cold pockets you observe.

changedBodyFields.sourceEnglish: Look for ice and plant damage, compare low ground with slopes, and check minimum temperatures where you can. Mark places where cold or damage lasts longest. Keep sensitive plants away from the cold pockets you observe.
changedBodyFields.targetText: Languta ayisi ni ku onhaka ka swimilani, pimanisa low ground na slopes, u tlhela u kambela minimum temperatures laha swi kotekaka. Fungha tindhawu laha cold or damage swi tshamaka kona nkarhi wo leha ngopfu. Hlayisa swimilani leswi khumbekaka hi ku olova swi ri ekule ni cold pockets leti u ti vonaka.

segments.text: Fungha tindhawu laha cold or damage swi tshamaka kona nkarhi wo leha ngopfu.
